comment: Orrun prop catalog. Meshes are produced by the Asset Lab at C:/Projekte/AssetGenerator (assets/specs -> assets/out/*.glb) and copied here by tools/sync_assets.py. Orrun never edits a .glb; if a mesh is wrong, fix its spec in the Asset Lab and regenerate.
wanted_from_asset_lab: cliff_face and talus variants for badlands and alpine
arch / overhang kits to dress natural overhangs
broadleaf and shrub species so plains and forest read differently
modular bridge spans (timber short, stone medium) with abutment pieces
